title: HBM share of DRAM wafer input vs bit supply, top-3 suppliers (TrendForce) and Micron wafer-intensity ratio

units.wafer_share_pct: % of total DRAM wafer input, top-3 suppliers
units.bit_share_pct: % of total DRAM bit supply, top-3 suppliers

conventions: Values are printed in the TrendForce press release text (rounded, 'approximately'). 2027 is a forecast; 2025 and 2026 are also TrendForce estimates (release dated 2026-06-02), the wafer figures stated 'by the end of' each year. The release says bit supply 'during the same period' without stating end-of-year vs annual.

trendforce.cite: TrendForce press release 2026-06-02, 'Tight DRAM Supply Gives Suppliers Greater Pricing Power in HBM, with HBM Contract Prices Expected to Surge Multiples Higher in 2027'
trendforce.locator: paragraph beginning 'TrendForce estimates that HBM wafer input among the top three suppliers...'

micron_mar2025.cite: Micron FQ2-25 earnings call prepared remarks

micron_dec2025.cite: Micron FQ1-26 earnings call prepared remarks

rows.loc: press release body, HBM share paragraph
rows.note: Quote: 'approximately 18%, 22%, and 30% of total DRAM wafer input by the end of 2025, 2026, and 2027'; 'approximately 8%, 9%, and 13% of total DRAM bit supply during the same period'.

rows.loc: press release body, HBM share paragraph
rows.note: Estimate as of June 2026, so the year is not complete.

rows.loc: press release body, HBM share paragraph
rows.note: Forecast. Implied wafer-per-bit ratio (computed from these shares, not independent of Micron's 3:1): 2025 (92/82)/(8/18)=2.52; 2026 (91/78)/(9/22)=2.85; 2027 (87/70)/(13/30)=2.87.

locators.hbm3e: 21-micron-mar2025.pdf p.6: 'HBM3E consumes three times the amount of silicon compared to D5 to produce the same number of bits.' Also 21-micron-dec2025.pdf p.5: '3-to-1 trade ratio with DDR5'.
locators.hbm4e: 21-micron-mar2025.pdf p.6: 'we expect the trade ratio to increase with HBM4 and then again with HBM4E when we expect it to exceed 4 to 1.'

extraction.agent_b: B: fetched press release HTML with curl and read the text; read Micron PDFs via pdftotext
extraction.method: printed numbers only, no chart reads

caveats: Circularity: the 2.5-2.9 wafer-per-bit ratio implied by the shares is computed from them and is not independent confirmation of Micron's 3:1.
Wafer shares are end-of-year; the release does not state whether bit shares are end-of-year or annual ('during the same period').
Shares cover the top three suppliers only; the 2025 and 2026 values are also estimates dated 2026-06-02.
